newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Malaria kills 147 in week across Zimbabwe.
newsitem.headline: Malaria kills 147 in week across Zimbabwe.

text.p: A malaria epidemic ravaging Zimbabwe killed 147 people in one week and left about 47,000 others ill in the worst recorded outbreak this year, the Health Ministry said on Thursday.

The ministry said in a statement the statistics from the second week of April pushed the 1997 malaria death toll to 795 from an epidemic blamed on heavy rains at the end of 1996 and the first three months of this year.
